<p>*Release Date: 2014-01-01* The R&D of 400mm diameter 1A1 cermet bond diamond grinding wheel and CBN grinding wheel was successfully completed, forming mass production and being launched to the market. In response to market and manufacturer demands, following the successful R&D of cermet grinding wheels for vertical axis and surface grinding (400mm diameter... wait, source says 300mm, thickness 20mm) in July 2013, and the successful development of grinding wheels for high-speed steel, titanium alloy, and high-temperature alloy in October, in November 2013, the 400mm diameter 1A1 cermet bond diamond grinding wheel and CBN grinding wheel was successfully developed again, forming mass production in January 2014, and beginning to be launched to the market. Sharpen New Materials successively developed a complete set of technologies for the preparation of high-performance cermet bond diamond grinding wheel and CBN grinding wheel with independent intellectual property rights, and strong slotting of high-speed steel rotating bodies, fully demonstrating Sharpen's strong R&D capability and innovation ability!</p>
